name: data.gov.sg dataset search (find ACRA A-Z datasets)
note: No key. Returns datasetId for each ACRA entities dataset (split by first letter A-Z + others). Collect all datasetIds.

name: data.gov.sg poll-download (ACRA entities CSV per dataset)
note: No key. Returns data.url = a signed (time-limited) S3 CSV URL; then GET that URL to download the CSV (53 cols, keyed on uen). Example: 'B' = d_3a3807c023c61ddfba947dc069eb53f2. Iterate all A-Z datasetIds.
